key c:minor
let pad_chords = <chord(cm9) chord(g#maj7) chord(fdim) chord(g7)>

let arp_base = arp(cm7, updown, 16)
section ambient_intro 16 bars {
  deck B: harmony pad_chords inst=am-pad vel=50..70
  deck A: melody piano_lead inst=piano vel=60..85
  master: filter lp 600 -> 2500 over 16 bars
  master: reverb 0.4
}
section evolving_theme 32 bars {
  deck B: harmony pad_chords inst=am-pad vel=45..65 | arp arp_base inst=electric-piano oct=4 vel=40..75
  deck A: melody piano_lead inst=piano vel=65..95 | bass <c2 g#1 f1 g1> inst=sub-bass len=12 vel=70

  deck A: melody piano_lead inst=piano vel=50..75
  master: filter lp 2500 -> 350 over 16 bars
  master: reverb 0.5
}

end after outro
